input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One single full body neutral identity master for a top-down 2D cultivation RPG NPC. Match a compact mature PIXEL CHIBI RPG person, about 2.8 heads tall, head about one third of standing height, short compact torso and legs, adult identity not toddler. Crisp stepped pixel clusters and dark one-pixel-style outlines; intentionally limited 3-tone material shading, no smooth painterly rendering, no antialias fuzz, no photographic 3D. This is concept artwork for a later 80-pixel-tall body on a 64x96 game canvas, not a claim that the generated image is native pixels. CAMERA: orthographic high angle around35degrees down, fixed SOUTHEAST front three-quarter view facing the lower right of the screen, both feet planted and soles clearly visible, no foreshortened camera tilt. One full figure only, centered with generous15percent empty margin on every side. Lighting soft from upper left. Style described from approved Vuong Lam Pixel02 and Van Ngoc V2; reference pixels are NOT transmitted. Keep outline and anatomy consistent with compact pixel RPG people; individuality from age, hair, costume, stance and small props. Background perfectly flat solid MAGENTA #FF00FF with no ground plane, no shadow, no reflected magenta. No aura, glow, particles, weapons beyond listed, scene, labels, text, contact sheet, grid, watermark or other characters. Preserve full silhouette and boot contact. Subject: An older adult female cultivation instructor. Salt and pepper hair in a compact bun, ivory and smoky sage blue robes, a small string of jade beads, a bamboo slip held near the abdomen. Both hands are low in a calm resting pose. Modest practical garment, composed mature face, no aura and no huge flowing sleeves. Owner original brief: Nữ lớn tuổi; tóc muối tiêu búi gọn, áo trắng ngà/xanh khói, ngọc chuỗi nhỏ, trúc giản. Tư thế tay trước bụng, dây ngọc nhỏ; thổ nạp có hơi khí sát tay, không phủ kín toàn thân.
